briefdescription.para: The future symbol table string section.
The future section header string table section, if a unique string table is needed.

detaileddescription.para: Don't reference this variable direectly: use the ShStrtabStrings member instead.

briefdescription.para: The future dynamic symbol string section.
The name of the section header string table section.

detaileddescription.para: If it is .strtab or .dynstr, the section header strings will be written to the same string table as the static/dynamic symbols respectively. Otherwise a dedicated section will be created with that name.
